sourcePolicyNotes: The unit profile is read only from compiled UNIT_CONFIG. No caller divides BAT by BaseAS.
All thirteen templates inherit AttackRangeBuffer250 from npc_dota_units_base, with include_keys_from applied first for Wolf4.
Ordinary basic AI can issue further orders that cancel backswing; this does not certify vanilla creep autonomous-order policy.
The adapter supplies attack/motion identity only. Skill-authored body health, damage, range, speed, lifetime and child eligibility remain separate authoritative AA behavior.
